summary: Correction: integration = coordinator merges exactly each shard's recorded last_green_sha into the integration branch, then check --all-shards verifies ancestry and gates the integrated tree. What must never happen is merging un-gated shard heads or merging the integration branch back into shard branches. Also: do not contract speculative shards (e.g. native_accel); they block --all-shards.
